Purpose and exclusions

Authored configuration for Capsule locomotion, sprint, jump, dodge and fall damage. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Select DA_Movement_Default in Content Browser; set DefinitionId to a stable domain ID, then set the fields in the linked feature contract.
  2. Assign this instance to the consuming native owner through its Blueprint child/defaults or catalog; a content file that is never assigned has no runtime effect.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Author and validate stable definition/frame/field identity before use; load through declared references at readiness.
  2. Consumers may cache read-only references for their world/session lifetime; do not mutate the shared definition or place player quantities on it.
  3. On reimport/version change validate compatibility and migrate persistent IDs deliberately. Missing required rules fail closed; missing cosmetic layers use documented fallback.
  4. World/pawn teardown releases runtime references; persistent records retain IDs and versions only. Reconnect resolves the same definition without replaying grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Capsule locomotion, sprint, jump, dodge and fall damage. Rule owner: URPGCharacterMovementComponent. This asset’s role is Authored configuration for Capsule locomotion, sprint, jump, dodge and fall damage. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

  1. Convert Axis2D into a fixed camera-ground forward/right basis. Normalize diagonal keyboard input without discarding analog magnitude.
  2. Feed AddMovementInput into CharacterMovement, not repeated SetActorLocation or a parallel Blueprint movement Tick.
  3. Extend saved-move prediction for sprint/dodge intent so a delayed reliable RPC cannot make speed state diverge from the move being simulated. This is a native implementation task requiring installed CMC API inspection.
  4. Server validates current movement mode, action permissions, stamina and displacement, then simulates the approved movement with capsule sweeps.
  5. Publish movement mode/velocity and accepted dodge sequence to presentation; no sprite notify changes location or restores a dodge budget.
  6. On landing, server computes the fall event once from its own grounded/falling history. GAS applies configured damage after Phase 07; Phase 02 logs the proposed event only.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_TerrainLab / Ramp30 / Stairs20 / Bridge / FallPit. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Diagonal full keyboard input -> same top speed as straight input, not sqrt(2) faster.
Dodge into a wall or bridge rail -> capsule stops/slides under collision; no teleport through it.
Sprint packet arrives late -> saved move/prediction corrects state; no permanent speed increase.
Jump repeated in air -> rejected under one-jump policy; changing sprite direction adds no jump.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not put mutable stock, current health, inventory quantities or player quest progress on a shared Data Asset. A soft reference still needs validation and readiness.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
